background.description: White paper, signed in black ink

notes: Verified against the official SSC CGL 2026 notification (para 9.6): signature must be uploaded in JPEG/JPG, 10-20 KB, about 6.0cm (width) x 2.0cm (height). SSC does not mandate an exact pixel size — the pixel target here renders that physical size at 200 DPI. IMPORTANT: SSC no longer requires a pre-made photo upload for this exam. Per para 9.4 of the same notification, the application itself captures a live photograph via webcam/camera during form-filling, and no pre-existing photo file is needed or accepted — that's why there is no ssc-cgl-photo preset. This appears to be a system-wide change across SSC's exams (confirmed for CHSL too), not CGL-specific.
